program.conclusion: Main runs on STA, gates duplicate processes with a named mutex, and enters Application.Run only on the createNew branch. InitPR returns a Task and is called without await/Wait/Result before hardware initialization.

mainFormLoad.conclusion: When axes are not reset and the mode is not offline, the main system tile is disabled and Load returns before DataLoad, pressure connections, lighting, and the background thread start.

productEdit.conclusion: The click handler rechecks working, DryCycle, and recipe prerequisites; UI state methods disable editing while running or paused and enable it in stop state.

production.behavior: Only the dock panel containing ucGuidMove is looked up and closed before Machine.Start; the method does not call CloseAllDockPanel.

boundaries: This audit reads current trunk source and records hashes/line anchors; it does not launch Program.Main, MainForm, Machine.Start, hardware, VM, or a device.
The source-confirmed async boundary does not establish that PR initialization has completed before any later consumer uses it.
The UI checks are source evidence for two start handlers and three state methods, not a complete permission or event-race proof.
